- Forecast consistently underestimates true prices, especially in the 30-day horizon; add a fixed upward bias of 2–5% to model outputs for short-term (1–7 day) forecasts.
- Model overreacts to recent spikes (e.g., 38.56 → 47.97), overshooting by 20–30% in 3–5 day windows; apply dampening factor to recent high forecasts.
- Mean reversion is weak in 30-day forecasts; if forecast exceeds 38.50, reduce by 0.5–1.0% per day until price stabilizes.
- Lagged price movements (e.g., 38.56 → 47.22) are not captured; add 1–2 day lag correction for 30-day forecasts by shifting true values backward by 1–2 days.
- Avoid overfitting to recent volatility; if 3 consecutive days show >5% price increase, reduce forecast by 1–2% to prevent over-optimism.
